map.安全（疏散/消防/承重）评估: Safety (Evacuation / Fire Protection / Load Bearing) Assessment

map.展会预算（费用/控制/优化）分析工具。输入展会各项支出与收入，按通用财务规则测算: Exhibition budget (expense / control / optimization) analysis tool. Enter the expenses and income of the show to compute the expense structure under general financial rules and give control and optimization advice, for exhibition cost management and ROI assessment.
map.把优化前后的费用明细分别跑一遍统计，用极差与方差量化优化效果，向管理层汇报改进幅: Run the statistics on the expense details before and after the optimization separately, and use the range and the variance to quantify the effect and report the magnitude of the improvement to management.
